<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
arange(start, stop=None, step=1, dtype=None)
```

Part of [`evoxc.numpy`](/api/evoxc/numpy/)

numpy.arange → Constant op with numpy.arange(start, stop, step) data.

v1: start/stop/step must be concrete Python numbers at trace time (they
specialize the graph); symbolic bounds raise TraceError and are deferred
to v2 (see CONTEXT.md). dtype=None → numpy's own inference over the
concrete bounds. For evenly spaced values with a given count, use
`evoxc.linspace` (Constant-op composition; float64 default dtype).

[View Python source](https://github.com/EMI-Group/evoxc/blob/main/evoxc/numpy/creation.py#L93)
